clips.title: The story
paras: Deathstalker Faerleia waits in Pyrewood Village, where Arugal's council keeps the afflicted in line. The Forsaken aim to break his hold on the town and weaken his position in Shadowfang Keep.

Deathstalker Faerleia waits inside Pyrewood Village's town hall for the local leaders. Archmage Arugal keeps to Shadowfang Keep, tending his dark sorceries, and leaves the Pyrewood Council to maintain order among the afflicted villagers. Faerleia plans to strike the council in an ambush. Without its mediation, the Forsaken hope the worgen in the surrounding woods and village streets will break free of Arugal's control.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You got here just in the nick of time, friend!

The Pyrewood Council will be returning any moment. Arugal has other matters to tend to in the keep. He uses the Council as mere puppets to keep the mindless minions of Pyrewood under his control. But I believe that without the guidance of the Pyrewood Council, the sons of Arugal will turn against their master.
I cannot handle them all by myself. I need you to help me. Together we can lay waste to the Council for Lady Sylvanas.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You fought like a true disciple of the Dark Lady, friend. With the council dead, perhaps we can gain control of this town once and for all and drive Arugal from Shadowfang Keep. I salute you!
